cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Congratulations on winning the cake contest, Mum. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your cake isn't on the judging table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It stayed in the kitchen where I can admire it privately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still beat seven cakes that had every intention of winning.

mechanism: A helps Mum present and serve her prize cake while deflecting how A withdrawal softened the competition.
confusable: Unlike openly gifting the prize, A keeps seven other competitors in view and hides the confidence-protecting reason.
comparison: Cake serving and prize handling differ from documenting a chess finishing move.
seedUse: D207-b A cake absent and seven rivals; S02-b offers practical celebration support while keeping Mum winner.
